claim_boundary: finite selected Chrono/TMeasy cells only; M3267 planar incompleteness remains; no universal detailed-vehicle, split-mu, moving-obstacle, cross-vehicle, or real-car claim

decision_rule.falsify: under healthy searches, slide beats grip by more than 0.25 m
decision_rule.inconclusive: any arm, seed, free, frame, tire, replay, or robustness gate fails
decision_rule.support: every health, pooled no-drift, seed-robust, and no-counterexample gate passes

frozen_feasibility_anchor.role: known feasible required-slide seed for search recall; it receives no extra actuator authority and is re-evaluated under every frozen cell

health_gates.all_seeds_complete: every dedicated arm/seed and pooled arm has finite D-star
health_gates.connector: local frame, finite rear tire truth, and exact replay <=1e-12
health_gates.free_consistency: dedicated free D-star <= best pooled constrained D-star +0.25 m
health_gates.positive_controls: M3265 literature and M3266 slide-entry controls remain true
health_gates.seed_robust: worst dedicated grip seed <= best dedicated slide seed +0.25 m

metric.d_star: minimum obstacle-center distance cleared; smaller is better

mode_and_geometry_contract.common: speed>=4 m/s, lane-aligned OBB, road containment, no collision
mode_and_geometry_contract.pooling: reclassify every stored best trajectory under every mode predicate
mode_and_geometry_contract.required_slide: four frames beta in [0.20,0.60], rear slip>=0.15, onset vehicle front before OBB near face, global beta<=0.70 through pass

primary_claim: Within three frozen Chrono/TMeasy lane-aligned static-OBB cells, pooled grip-mode D-star is no larger than required controlled-slide D-star by more than 0.25 m.

seed_discipline.arm_streams: disjoint, with identical budgets within each cell
seed_discipline.quick_full: disjoint cells and SHA256-derived optimizer streams

stop_rule: This is the final detailed-model optimizer route. Any failed quick/full gate stops further local search repair and leaves empirical support unproved.
